content.value: Design a sequential circuit with two SR FFs A and B and two inputs E and x. If E=0, the circuit rémains in the same state, regardless of the value of x. When E=1 and x=1, the circuit goes through the state transitions from 00 to 01 to 10 to 11 back to 00, and repeats. When E=1 and $\mathbf { x } { = } 0 ;$ the circuit goes through the state transitions from 00 to 11 to 10 to 01 and back to ${ \displaystyle \cdot 0 0 _ { j } }$ and repeats.
